status: Network-only lifecycle passed on official Terraform 1.16.6 and AWS 6.68.0. Real guardian ELB package race tests passed. ALB Terraform was not run here.
scope: Network control lifecycle is independent of genuine native packet execution. ALB uses only existing real Docker relay/EC2 network owner. No QEMU guests or isolation are invented.
prerequisites: Complete examples shared preparation; EXAMPLE_PYTHON must import boto3 and shared examples/local.py.
Use official Terraform 1.15.9 or later. Use the integrated real controller and the built static Linux relay.

For ALB install dig, Docker/native packet-policy prerequisites documented in docs/behavior-references.md Application Load Balancer kernel; use a local supported Docker socket and existing namespace privileges.

Prepare an AWS 6.68.0 Terraform filesystem mirror. The available /tmp/stackd-terraform-eip-59nmy6o_ is prior cache/artifacts, not automatically assumed to be a valid filesystem-mirror root; select the directory with registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws/6.68.0/linux_amd64 layout.
Use an unused owned port. The runner owns its controller, SQLite database and Terraform state.
The default target uses an installed real Linux/amd64 BusyBox image. The exercised image is busybox:1.38.0. Keep native ECS prerequisites.

Terraform owns official ECS task/execution role trust, execution policy, data-role readback, cluster/task/service prerequisites and destroys them after dependent ALB resources. No guest or read-only seed database is invented.

prepared_target_variables_shape.targets: map: arbitrary stable target key -> {ip: actual private IPv4 address, port: actual listening HTTP port, availability_zone: actual zone or all}
prepared_target_variables_shape.expected_target_body: Exact body served by each genuine target on /forward; no placeholder target endpoint is supplied.

native_desync_prerequisite.assembly: Construct desync.New(controllerContext, absoluteTrustedExecutable); pass elbv2.Config.DesyncClassifier; stop services/runtime before classifier.Close. CLI flag -elbv2-desync-executable is parent-owned.
native_desync_prerequisite.lifetime: New context bounds initialization only. Every classification/Health has its own maximum two-second deadline. Native failure poisons and kills the helper; no fallback. Idempotent Close waits for reaping or returns an explicit two-second timeout.
native_desync_prerequisite.effect: Official library classifies original HTTP1 raw bytes before net/http, including plaintext after real TLS: compliant/acceptable normal, ambiguous completes response and closes client plus target, severe rejects with400 and no forwarding. Streaming/chunk/pipeline protocol failures fail closed.
native_desync_prerequisite.evidence: The parent installed this pinned official adapter and passed its native race test. This worker passed ELB package race tests with the real adapter. ALB Terraform remains unrun.

stages_executed_by_runner: Check Terraform version, allocate unique owned private directory, install publisher-checked current provider with no development override or direct fallback in mirror mode.

Start owned controller through examples/local.py controller(extra=...,containers=True for ALB), verify signed STS identity, terraform init. Default ALB run first applies network plus actual ECS target with enable_alb=false; independently verify native PID/log output/private-IP bytes before applying ALB with the actual task address.
Consume signed EC2 network state. Save refresh-only and ordinary plans. Each must return 0. Retain failures until after cleanup.

For ALB consume explicit UDP DNS then real hostname HTTP fixed response, and if targets supplied require actual healthy HTTP probe observations plus exact real forwarded bytes. Successful resource metadata is never readiness.

Save private before-import.tfstate. Import every owned network/ALB identity plus enabled ECS cluster/task/service and IAM roles/policy with pinned-provider identifiers; native resources are not deleted. Both no-change plans and consumers must still work.

Set revision=two and apply actual target task-definition/code update plus tags/ENI description/fixed-response changes; independently consume new native target bytes, discover its real current IP, update attachment and reconsume ALB forwarding. Retained network IDs must remain stable; both no-change plans must pass.
Stop and reopen the same owned controller database. Repeat native consumers and both strict no-change plans.

Always destroy even after failed apply; verify network/LB/managed ENI absence, owned target containers and IAM roles gone, and no managed Terraform resources. Retain output/state/SQLite/controller logs privately.

import_identifiers.aws_ecs_task_definition: full revision ARN; pinned ecs/task_definition.go parseRevisionParts

source_backed_corrections: DescribeCapacityReservation reads a scoped existing LB with no configured reservation; no units, provisioned zones, AWS decrement allowance or timestamp are fabricated. Mutation remains unsupported.
Disabled access/connection/health logging writes and reads reflect actual absence of delivery. Enabling logging still fails explicitly rather than pretending S3 received records.

Native HTTP1 implements default one-hour accepted-connection lifetime: first request after expiry receives Connection: close after its full response. Arbitrary keepalive values remain rejected; no metadata-only timer state.
Static native attribute admission reflects existing real HTTP1, Host preservation, append-XFF and disabled optional behavior. HTTP2=true or incompatible advanced settings are not accepted.

Broker EC2 Allocate/Observe/Release use existing durable private owner+creation records and requester-managed ENIs, reserved subnet capacity, deterministic DEFAULT AZ placement and current compute/network packet policy; native Kafka consumer owns physical attach/readiness.
compute/network permits only stackd_msk_<lowercase hexadecimal> ownership namespace alongside existing namespaces, with exact-controller cleanup fence retained.
explicit_native_prerequisites_and_settin: Current-provider defensive desync requires the installed pinned official classifier adapter. Missing or failed native classifier is explicitly rejected, never represented as supported metadata.
Listener baseline attributes are available but unverified. Mutable response headers/Server removal and TLS/mTLS request renaming remain unsupported.

Target default effects and deregistration delay are implemented but unverified. Provider minimal create emits deregistration delay only, not every readback default. Nondefault stickiness/slow-start/algorithms/anomaly/cross-zone/health controls and NLB/GWLB/Lambda settings remain unsupported.
Network-only lifecycle passed. Guardian-backed raw HTTP tests passed. ALB Terraform and native packet isolation remain unverified. Do not relax assertions.
focused_checks_for_parent_once_all_owner: Existing EC2/ELBv2 memory/SQLite and native runtime regression suites; actual Kafka real produce/consume with SG/NACL deny/reallow belongs to Kafka owner fixture.
Run commands_for_parent sequentially only after adapter/CLI integration. Real-library test environment must be set; missing adapter skips are not exercised evidence.
